release_notes:
Reliability and resource improvements.

This release hardens the app so it keeps working on its own through the kinds of interruptions that previously required a restart -- most importantly when a computer sleeps for a long time (overnight or over a weekend) and then wakes:

- Workstation discovery now recovers automatically after a sleep/wake, a network-adapter hiccup, or switching between Wi-Fi and a wired connection. Before, discovery could quietly stop and a station would appear offline until the app was restarted.

- The internal alert-delivery loop and the wake-recovery loop can no longer be stopped by a single unexpected error, so incoming Ready alerts keep arriving even after days of uptime.

- Beacons are now also sent to the local subnet broadcast, which reaches other workstations more reliably on some office networks.

It also lowers background resource use: this machine's network address is checked far less often and off the main thread (no more brief freezes), alert sounds are cached instead of regenerated on every play, and a few small memory/handle leaks were closed. No changes to how you use the app.
